feature_request: create a multi agent system which calls groq api and tells it to act as a software engineer and also tell it to create a testing agent
acceptance_criteria: Validates API request JSON structure and required fields before processing
Limits API calls to 100 requests per hour per user
Calls Groq API with role 'software engineer' and receives response
Instantiates testing agent and verifies it generates test cases for given code
plan:
Create a new multi-agent system consisting of three new Python modules: (1) groq_agent.py – handles validation of request JSON, enforces a 100 requests per hour limit per user, and calls the Groq API with role "software engineer"; (2) testing_agent.py – receives code snippets from the main system, generates test cases, and returns them; (3) multi_agent_system.py – orchestrates user requests, invokes groq_agent for software engineering actions, then instantiates testing_agent to produce tests. Each module includes docstrings and minimal error handling to satisfy the acceptance criteria while keeping existing tests untouched.
